title: Houthis Claim Missile Strikes Killed Dozens of Saudi Troops
detail: Houthi forces claimed their latest missile salvo killed dozens of Saudi troops in what they described as their most significant battlefield victory against Saudi forces. The claim could not be independently verified, but represents a major escalation in Houthi offensive operations targeting Saudi military personnel.

title: Saudi Arabia Launches Retaliatory Airstrikes on Houthi Targets
detail: Saudi Arabia launched retaliatory airstrikes against Houthi targets following deadly Houthi attacks on Riyadh and two Saudi airports. The strikes mark a significant escalation in Saudi counter-offensive operations as both sides exchange increasingly high-impact blows.

title: Syria Denies Joining Yemen War, Declares Support for Saudi Arabia
detail: Syria officially denied joining the Yemen war and declared it stands with Saudi Arabia against the Houthis, a notable diplomatic alignment given Syria's historically complex regional position. The statement signals a significant shift in Syrian foreign policy as the conflict widens.

title: Houthis Claim to Have Shot Down Saudi Drone Over Taiz
detail: Houthi forces claimed to have shot down a Saudi drone over Taiz, marking continued air-defense activity in southern Yemen. The claimed intercept reflects ongoing aerial engagements in the Taiz region as Houthi forces contest Saudi-coalition drone operations.
